title: Design pass: page data has one store, git is the first write, no copy step
why:
The page database and git drift apart, so the owner sees stale data; he ruled one store with no lag. 23:12 CST Nov 14 REST read, status unchanged: #2829 is closed and not merged (13:40 CST Nov 13); #3212 replaces it and is open, draft, last update 16:35 CST Nov 14. 23:15 CST Nov 14 (coordinator): stays doing. 23:34 CST Nov 14 (lane on PRs 3255, 3154, 3212, session_013NEJKywGFp9cTkWDRfdG4K): PR #3212 (draft) round 1 failed because the 12:40 CST Nov 12 ruling reads two ways: decision page-one-store line 34 says git is the home and the database the live view; step waiting-copy-backup-only says the database is the one store and git a backup. Already ruled, so no owner item posted: ruling page-git-is-home holds owner 12:11 CST Nov 13, page item 730 (pick-page-git-truth) a, "accepted pick": git is home, the database is the live view; it says the 12:40 CST Nov 12 text fits only on timing. The lane's option A is that ruling. #3212 still needs a builder for four stale cites and wrong blockedBy lines (coordinator's call, not an owner pick).

[00:16 CST Nov 16, triage] Full note before the trim to 200 words (goal item 6, option b):
Ruled outcome: one store, no copy step, no lag; git is the first write; a design pass picks the route. No step held the design pass before this one. Related R28 steps, all todo with no lane: prose-tending-contract, prose-tending-move-stores, feedback-log-tends-itself, waiting-export-miss-cloud (it only patches the copy step), shared-job-finder. Output: the chosen route in a decision record, then build steps. Ranked by hand until step queue-score-plus-agent lands. Ready, no lane. Coordinator picks 11:43 CST Nov 12: the page polls about every 30 s and refreshes on load and focus; a guard refuses session writes to waiting/answers/**. Eight build steps come at hand-in. Route D picked (decision waiting-page-one-store); nine build steps filed 11:55 CST Nov 12: page-git-connector-probe, page-one-store-answers, waiting-item-check, page-reads-writes-git, writer-writes-git, page-db-off-guard, retire-page-copy, answers-session-write-guard, status-tab-reads-git. Proof case (retrospective 12:41 CST Nov 12): measured 12:40 CST, the live page held 577 items and waiting/items on origin/roadmap held 519, so the git copy was 58 behind, with stands items 560-590 among them. Owner 12:38 CST: "but ya the git copy ougth toh have had it good call". Owner route question posted as page item 593 (a = the page database is the one store, git a backup; b = route B, git on his own site). Route B steps stay measure-only, no deploy, until he answers. Owner picked a on item 593, in chat 12:40 CST Nov 12: the page database is the one store, with a timely (not real-time) export to git; he stays open to route B if lanes plus triage cause internal lag. Lane rewrites decision waiting-page-one-store on #2829 and sends re-cut route a steps through the coordinator. Correction 12:06 CST Nov 13 (coordinator 12:05 CST): the three audit fixes are a follow-up step, page-one-store-fixes, not part of #2829. #2829 is in batch 136 (go 12:05 CST). Page item 730 (pick-page-git-truth) asks the owner whether git or the database is the truth; the retrospective asked that #2829 stay a draft until he answers.
source: owner R28, Nov 11 11:39 to 11:55 CST (restart plan item 3.14): "ya if anything the actual page gets its database disableed if that's possible and then it's never an issue ... remember ij just care about the outcomes not the plumbing to reach it"; owner 11:24 CST Nov 12 via the retrospective: "it shouldn't be a skill thing though it should be pretty mechanized"
